sources.title: Chewing Gum — Morrison County Historical Society

notes: 本条记录商品化口香糖。咀嚼树脂的习俗远早于1848年；森普尔1869年专利涉及特定橡胶配方，不能据此认定其为全部口香糖的发明者。
notes_en: The dates concern manufactured gum and a specific composition patent, not the ancient practice of chewing plant resins.
summary_zh: 口香糖由可咀嚼的胶基与调味成分制成。人类咀嚼植物树脂的习俗十分古老；1848年缅因州云杉树脂口香糖已作为商品出售，1869年森普尔又获得特定配方专利。
summary_en: People chewed plant resins long before manufactured gum. Spruce gum was sold commercially in Maine in 1848; Semple patented a rubber-based composition in 1869.
